units.source_text: 四十九日之内，众妃嫔一齐在桐壶院举哀，过后各自散归。

en.t: During the forty-nine days of mourning, all the consorts and ladies observed the rites together at the Kiritsubo院, and afterward each returned to her own place.

units.source_text: 断七之日，正是十二月二十。

en.t: The final seventh-day memorial fell exactly on the twentieth day of the twelfth month.
It was the cold end of the year, and layered clouds hung dim in the sky.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后心中更为阴惨，全无晴朗之日。

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo's heart grew still darker, without a single day of brightness.

units.source_text: 她深知弘徽殿太后的性行，设想在此人任情弄权的世间，做人定多痛苦。

en.t: She knew well the character and conduct of the Kokiden Empress Dowager, and imagined that in a world where such a person wielded power as she pleased, life would surely be full of suffering.

units.source_text: 但这还在其次，最使她悲伤不已的，是多年来亲近的桐壶院的面影，

en.t: But even that came second; what grieved her most was the image of the Kiritsubo院, whom she had been close to for so many years,

units.source_text: 时刻不离开她的心头，加之一向聚集在这宫中的诸侍从，不能长留在此，

en.t: which never left her heart for a moment, and besides, the many attendants who had always gathered in this palace could no longer remain there,
so she had no choice but to let them disperse one after another.
